sentence: Older customers time out on the identify step before they finish typing.
reviewer_notes: Code facts read before running the skill: js/app.js idleWarnMs = 40 s of no tap, then #idle-dialog (modal, Escape blocked) with a 20 s countdown that calls resetSession() and wipes the DOM. Every on-screen tap and every physical key resets the 40 s timer (touch()). So the failure is per-keystroke gaps > 40 s on the DOB/name keypads, and a 20 s modal countdown that an older person must find and dismiss with 'I'm still here' — otherwise their partial input is lost. Expected fix: longer idle window on the identify screens (partial DOB / last name is the visitor's own typing, not fetched PHI), longer/dismiss-anywhere warning, keep the typed value on 'still here' (already kept), and a visible cue that the entry was kept. Should NOT weaken the privacy wipe on list/confirm where fetched prescription data is on screen. Keypad, tokens, typography and utilbar stay as-is.
